package unit

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
)

type seedRouteFile struct {
	Lessons []seedRouteLesson `json:"lessons"`
}

type seedRouteLesson struct {
	Tasks []seedRouteTask `json:"tasks"`
}

type seedRouteTask struct {
	TaskKind               string          `json:"task_kind"`
	ExecutionMode          string          `json:"execution_mode"`
	EvaluationMode         string          `json:"evaluation_mode"`
	UIMode                 string          `json:"ui_mode"`
	SubmissionMode         string          `json:"submission_mode"`
	RequiresSandbox        bool            `json:"requires_sandbox"`
	ExposesPreview         bool            `json:"exposes_preview"`
	ExposesTerminal        bool            `json:"exposes_terminal"`
	SupportsLiveValidation bool            `json:"supports_live_validation"`
	CodeStructureTypeCode  string          `json:"code_structure_type_code"`
	CodeStructure          json.RawMessage `json:"code_structure"`
}

func TestValidationContractSeedRouteIsConsistent(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	routePath := filepath.Join("..", "..", "db", "seeds", "test", "routes", "validation-contracts-lab.json")
	data, err := os.ReadFile(routePath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read seed route: %v", err)
	}

	var route seedRouteFile
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &route); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unmarshal seed route: %v", err)
	}

	if len(route.Lessons) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected at least one lesson")
	}

	for lessonIndex, lesson := range route.Lessons {
		if len(lesson.Tasks) == 0 {
			t.Fatalf("lesson %d should contain tasks", lessonIndex)
		}

		for taskIndex, task := range lesson.Tasks {
			taskType, err := domain.ParseTaskType(task.TaskKind)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("parse task type for lesson %d task %d: %v", lessonIndex, taskIndex, err)
			}

			if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(taskType, task.CodeStructure); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("validate contract for lesson %d task %d: %v", lessonIndex, taskIndex, err)
			}

			caps, err := domain.InferTaskCapabilities(task.CodeStructureTypeCode, task.CodeStructure, domain.TaskCapabilityInput{})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("infer capabilities for lesson %d task %d: %v", lessonIndex, taskIndex, err)
			}

			assertTaskCapabilityMatchesSeed(t, lessonIndex, taskIndex, caps, task)
		}
	}
}

func TestTypeScriptRuntimeSeedSourceIsConsistent(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	sourcePath := filepath.Join("..", "..", "db", "seeds", "test", "sources", "engine-ts-runtime-fixtures.json")
	data, err := os.ReadFile(sourcePath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read TypeScript runtime seed source: %v", err)
	}

	var source seedRouteFile
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &source); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unmarshal TypeScript runtime seed source: %v", err)
	}
	if len(source.Lessons) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 3 TypeScript runtime lessons, got %d", len(source.Lessons))
	}

	for lessonIndex, lesson := range source.Lessons {
		if len(lesson.Tasks) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("lesson %d should contain exactly one task", lessonIndex)
		}
		task := lesson.Tasks[0]
		taskType, err := domain.ParseTaskType(task.TaskKind)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("parse task type for lesson %d: %v", lessonIndex, err)
		}
		if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(taskType, task.CodeStructure); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("validate TypeScript runtime contract for lesson %d: %v", lessonIndex, err)
		}
		caps, err := domain.InferTaskCapabilities(task.CodeStructureTypeCode, task.CodeStructure, domain.TaskCapabilityInput{})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("infer capabilities for lesson %d: %v", lessonIndex, err)
		}
		assertTaskCapabilityMatchesSeed(t, lessonIndex, 0, caps, task)
	}
}

func TestBrowserRuntimeSeedSourceIsConsistent(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	sourcePath := filepath.Join("..", "..", "db", "seeds", "test", "sources", "engine-browser-runtime-fixtures.json")

		t.Fatalf("expected 4 browser runtime lessons, got %d", len(source.Lessons))

	for lessonIndex, lesson := range source.Lessons {

			t.Fatalf("lesson %d should contain exactly one task", lessonIndex)
		}
		task := lesson.Tasks[0]

			t.Fatalf("parse task type for lesson %d: %v", lessonIndex, err)
		}
		if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(taskType, task.CodeStructure); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("validate browser runtime contract for lesson %d: %v", lessonIndex, err)

		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("infer capabilities for lesson %d: %v", lessonIndex, err)
		}
		assertTaskCapabilityMatchesSeed(t, lessonIndex, 0, caps, task)
	}
}

}

func TestPHPCoreSeedSourceIsLiveConsistent(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	sourcePath := filepath.Join("..", "..", "db", "seeds", "test", "sources", "engine-php-core-fixtures.json")
	data, err := os.ReadFile(sourcePath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read PHP core seed source: %v", err)
	}

	var source seedRouteFile
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &source); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unmarshal PHP core seed source: %v", err)
	}
	if len(source.Lessons) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 3 PHP core lessons, got %d", len(source.Lessons))
	}

	for lessonIndex, lesson := range source.Lessons {
		if len(lesson.Tasks) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("lesson %d should contain exactly one task", lessonIndex)
		}
		task := lesson.Tasks[0]
		taskType, err := domain.ParseTaskType(task.TaskKind)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("parse task type for lesson %d: %v", lessonIndex, err)
		}
		if err := domain.ValidateTaskContract(taskType, task.CodeStructure); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("validate PHP core contract for lesson %d: %v", lessonIndex, err)
		}
		caps, err := domain.InferTaskCapabilities(task.CodeStructureTypeCode, task.CodeStructure, domain.TaskCapabilityInput{})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("infer capabilities for lesson %d: %v", lessonIndex, err)
		}
		if !task.SupportsLiveValidation || !caps.SupportsLiveValidation {
			t.Fatalf("lesson %d should advertise inferred PHP live validation", lessonIndex)
		}
		if err := domain.ValidatePHPCoreLiveValidationCapability(task.CodeStructure, task.SupportsLiveValidation); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("validate live capability for lesson %d: %v", lessonIndex, err)
		}
	}
}

func assertTaskCapabilityMatchesSeed(
	t *testing.T,
	lessonIndex int,
	taskIndex int,
	caps domain.TaskCapabilities,
	task seedRouteTask,
) {
	t.Helper()

	expectedType, err := domain.ParseTaskType(task.TaskKind)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse task type for lesson %d task %d: %v", lessonIndex, taskIndex, err)
	}
	expectedExecutionMode, err := domain.ParseTaskExecutionMode(task.ExecutionMode)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse execution mode for lesson %d task %d: %v", lessonIndex, taskIndex, err)
	}
	expectedEvaluationMode, err := domain.ParseTaskEvaluationMode(task.EvaluationMode)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse evaluation mode for lesson %d task %d: %v", lessonIndex, taskIndex, err)
	}
	expectedUIMode, err := domain.ParseTaskUIMode(task.UIMode)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse ui mode for lesson %d task %d: %v", lessonIndex, taskIndex, err)
	}
	expectedSubmissionMode, err := domain.ParseTaskSubmissionMode(task.SubmissionMode)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse submission mode for lesson %d task %d: %v", lessonIndex, taskIndex, err)
	}

	if caps.Type != expectedType {
		t.Fatalf("lesson %d task %d: expected type %d, got %d", lessonIndex, taskIndex, expectedType, caps.Type)
	}
	if caps.ExecutionMode != expectedExecutionMode {
		t.Fatalf("lesson %d task %d: expected execution mode %d, got %d", lessonIndex, taskIndex, expectedExecutionMode, caps.ExecutionMode)
	}
	if caps.EvaluationMode != expectedEvaluationMode {
		t.Fatalf("lesson %d task %d: expected evaluation mode %d, got %d", lessonIndex, taskIndex, expectedEvaluationMode, caps.EvaluationMode)
	}
	if caps.UIMode != expectedUIMode {
		t.Fatalf("lesson %d task %d: expected ui mode %d, got %d", lessonIndex, taskIndex, expectedUIMode, caps.UIMode)
	}
	if caps.SubmissionMode != expectedSubmissionMode {
		t.Fatalf("lesson %d task %d: expected submission mode %d, got %d", lessonIndex, taskIndex, expectedSubmissionMode, caps.SubmissionMode)
	}
	if caps.RequiresSandbox != task.RequiresSandbox {
		t.Fatalf("lesson %d task %d: expected requires_sandbox %t, got %t", lessonIndex, taskIndex, task.RequiresSandbox, caps.RequiresSandbox)
	}
	if caps.ExposesPreview != task.ExposesPreview {
		t.Fatalf("lesson %d task %d: expected exposes_preview %t, got %t", lessonIndex, taskIndex, task.ExposesPreview, caps.ExposesPreview)
	}
	if caps.ExposesTerminal != task.ExposesTerminal {
		t.Fatalf("lesson %d task %d: expected exposes_terminal %t, got %t", lessonIndex, taskIndex, task.ExposesTerminal, caps.ExposesTerminal)
	}
	if caps.SupportsLiveValidation != task.SupportsLiveValidation {
		t.Fatalf("lesson %d task %d: expected supports_live_validation %t, got %t", lessonIndex, taskIndex, task.SupportsLiveValidation, caps.SupportsLiveValidation)
	}
}
